{"agents":[{"name":"planner","prompt":"Read TASK.md at the repository root. If it does not exist, use the
uncommitted changes (`git diff`) as the task.
Produce a numbered plan (at most 7 steps): the files to touch and the
command or check that proves each step. Do not edit any files.
End with PLAN_READY."},{"name":"advisor","prompt":"Review this plan against the task. Call out at most 5 concrete risks or
corrections; say what is over-scoped or unverifiable.
If the plan is safe to execute, end with exactly `VERDICT: accept`.
Otherwise end with exactly `VERDICT: revise`.

Plan:
{{ node "planner" }}"},{"name":"executor","prompt":"Implement the accepted plan. Work in the repository, run the checks the
plan names, and fix failures. Do not stop at a sketch: the change must be
on disk and verified.
End with exactly `DONE` when it is complete and verified.

Plan:
{{ node "planner" }}

Advice:
{{ node "advisor" }}"},{"name":"reviewer","prompt":"Review the implementation against the plan and the task. Re-run the
checks. Only correctness, scope, and verification count.
End with exactly `VERDICT: lgtm` if it is done, or
`VERDICT: lbtm` plus one sentence naming what must change.

Plan:
{{ node "planner" }}

Implementation:
{{ node "executor" }}"}]}

crew default
roles (crew-declared): advisor profile=Advisor

                             ← reviewer [verdict:lbtm] loop max_visits=2

                             ← executor [idle]
